reuse.why: Puts the rule inside the existing shared linkBankSyncAccount that every provider's link handler already delegates to, and reuses its account lookup instead of adding a second query.

duplication.why: The upgrading-account lookup is hoisted and reused for both the closed check and the update branch, so no logic is repeated.

placement.why: The guard lives in the shared link function, before the already-linked check, bank creation and sync, which is where link preconditions belong in this tree.

scope.why: Only the guard, the hoisted lookup and targeted tests.

maintainability.why: Small, clear precondition in one place that all providers inherit automatically.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six provider link functions call linkBankSyncAccount; the check is inside it.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the existing lookup was moved, not copied.
